title: Five equivalent formulations of property (P) of a ring
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects five equivalent formulations of the ring-theoretic property (P): the property itself, universal injectivity of injective maps of projective modules, finiteness and projectivity of the cokernel of an injection of finite projective modules, the splitting of inclusions of finite projective modules, and the splitting of injections from the ring into a finite free module. The proof quotes the implication from the property to universal injectivity, notes the equivalence of the two splitting statements, derives them from universal injectivity, and closes the cycle from the last statement by showing that a non-split injection of the ring into a finite free module would exhibit a proper finitely generated ideal violating the property.
